properties.name: Downtown Loop
properties.notes: Central interchange hub for all regional spokes — west corridor via Oak Park to Oakbrook.

properties.name: O'Hare International (ORD)
properties.notes: Northwest airport terminus — twin-tube links include Downtown and Lombard.

properties.name: Midway International (MDW)
properties.notes: Southwest-side airport terminus — south corridor toward Orland Park/Joliet; also links to Burr Ridge hub.

properties.name: Oak Park
properties.notes: Near-west hub in Oak Park along the I-290 corridor — twin-tube links to Downtown, Oakbrook, O'Hare, Midway, and Burr Ridge.

properties.name: Oakbrook Center
properties.notes: West-suburban retail / employment node — east to Oak Park/Downtown, west/northwest to Lombard and Woodridge, south to Burr Ridge.

properties.name: Lombard
properties.notes: DuPage hub in Lombard (near Yorktown corridor) — twin-tube links to Oakbrook, Woodridge, and O'Hare.

properties.name: Woodridge
properties.notes: Woodridge hub at the I-88 / I-355 interchange — park-and-ride access; links to Oakbrook, Naperville, Lombard, Bolingbrook, and Burr Ridge.

properties.name: Naperville
properties.notes: Western suburban hub — links via Woodridge toward Oakbrook/Downtown, twin-tube to Woodfield, south via Bolingbrook toward Joliet, and southwest to Plainfield.

properties.name: Bolingbrook
properties.notes: Southwest suburban hub in Bolingbrook, splitting the Naperville–Joliet twin-tube corridor; also links west to Plainfield, north to Woodridge, and east to Burr Ridge.

properties.name: Plainfield
properties.notes: Far southwest hub in Plainfield — twin-tube links to Naperville, Bolingbrook, and Joliet.

properties.name: Woodfield Mall
properties.notes: Northwest suburban interchange (Schaumburg) — twin-tube links to O'Hare, Naperville, and Evanston.

properties.name: East Chicago
properties.notes: Northwest Indiana hub in East Chicago — twin-tube links to Downtown Loop and Joliet.

properties.name: Orland Park
properties.notes: Southwest suburban hub in Orland Park — corridor toward Midway/Joliet; also links to Burr Ridge hub.

properties.name: Burr Ridge
properties.notes: I-55 corridor hub serving Darien, Willowbrook, and Burr Ridge — twin-tube links to Bolingbrook, Woodridge, Oakbrook, Oak Park, Midway, Orland Park, and Joliet.

properties.name: Joliet
properties.notes: Southwest suburban hub — twin-tube links to Orland Park, Burr Ridge, East Chicago, Bolingbrook (toward Naperville), and Plainfield; no Downtown corridor.

properties.name: Evanston
properties.notes: North-shore lakefront hub (Evanston / Northwestern area) — twin-tube links to Downtown and Woodfield.
